'''Champala''', also called "'''Chagria'''," was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and the homeworld of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] people. Most of its starports were high and dry on plateaus, but its [[City/Legends|cities]] were submerged at high tide. It was a popular resort world.

==Description==
[[File:MasAmedda-FF81.png|thumb|left|150px|A Chagrian]]
Champala was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] between [[Eeropha system|Nierport]] and [[Drearia/Legends|Drearia]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was considered a [[Water/Legends|water]] world, though it possessed several small continents covered in jungles and rainforests, with the occasional high plateau. The tidal zones of Champala consisted of long, thin strips of land.

==History==
Civilization on Champala originated in these long strips of coastline, where sea levels fluctuated wildly with the tides. Buildings in these ancient cities were entirely submerged at high tide, and [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]] swam between them. Some multi-story buildings were not equipped with staircases or elevators at all; inhabitants simply waited until high tide, then swam to higher floors. Once the Chagrians made contact with other [[Species/Legends|species]], they constructed starports and trade cities on high plateaus accessible by aircar.

Around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a number of needy Chagrian locals were approached by recruiters sent by [[Hugo Bartyn]]. Bartyn wanted amphibian fishermen to settle a new city in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] and tempted these poverty-stricken individuals with promises of untouched seas in a new frontier. Once they arrived, however, they became [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] laborers.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

Champala would come to be represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]; eventually [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] would be elected senator in the final years of the Republic.

Champala was heavily polluted during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after a series of mining accidents. The Chagrians played a part in liberating [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] from the Empire, and their planet was an initial member of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], remaining part of both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

At the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Battle of Champala]] was fought there.
